info.title: Sathi API
info.description: Public API (/api/v1) used by the Sathi web app. Cookie auth (sathi.auth) + antiforgery header X-XSRF-TOKEN on every non-GET request. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with code, traceId and referenceId. Source of truth: docs/architecture/contracts.md.
